profile.visual_desc: Muscular human in dark blue plate armor with gold trim. Features a long flowing red cape and spiky navy blue hair.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stern masculine face with sharp eyes, framed by spiky blue hair and a thick red headband. Facing left.
profile.weapon_desc: A heavy silver longsword held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view. Standing with sword held high, red cape draped, facing up-left.
profile.step2_windup: Crouches slightly to build power, sword remains raised as the cape begins to shift.
profile.step3_impact: Deep lunge with a downward swing, creating a massive fan-shaped yellow and white energy burst radiating upward.
profile.step4_finish: Low recovery stance; the bright flash transitions into blue energy trails as the cape billows high.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The fan-shaped yellow energy in Frame 4 correctly erupts along the downward trajectory of the sword swing.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation sequence maintains sufficient consistency with reference poses and VFX. The expansion to 10 frames preserves anatomical integrity and directional flow.
